tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List active JetForge tokens still on their bonding curve, with live price, reserves and graduation progress (0-100%). Graduated tokens trade on Raydium and are not listed.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Price a buy or sell from the token's live on-chain bonding curve, including the 1% fee, price impact and minimum output. Sends nothing. If partialFill is true, the buy would complete the curve and solCharged is what would actually be spent.

tools.name: prepare_trade
tools.description: Build an UNSIGNED buy or sell transaction (base64, legacy format) for the given wallet. This does not execute the trade or move funds. To execute it, sign with that wallet and broadcast to Solana before lastValidBlockHeight. Never send a private key to this tool or any other.

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.description: Get the SOL balance and SPL token balances of any Solana wallet.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_trade" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
